paper_record.title: Attosecond circular-dichroism spectroscopy of hole ring currents
paper_record.abstract: Ultrafast ionization of atoms by circularly polarized few-cycle laser pulses generates a hole ring currents, offering a route for ultrafast manipulation of magnetism. Here we explore the subcycle formation of these currents whose circulation direction is determined by the driving-field helicity, whereas their magnitude is governed by the quantum coherence of the residual ion. We show that the correlated ion-photoelectron dynamics can be probed with attosecond transient-absorption circular dichroism. Using the Wigner-Eckart theorem, we derive a linear relation between state-resolved dichroic absorption and the orbital and spin angular-momentum projections of the hole, thereby extending the Thole-Carra magnetic CD sum rules from static X-ray spectroscopy to attosecond electron dynamics. The modulation depth of the dichroic signal provides a direct optical measure of the coherence injected by ionization, and its dependence on the pump-pulse duration reveals a competition between coherence build-up and ionization-induced dephasing. These findings demonstrate the potential of attosecond circular dichroism for probing ionic coherence and highlight the role of quantum coherence in ultrafast angular momentum exchange between light and matter.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 提出了一种利用阿秒瞬态吸收圆二色谱实时探测原子中空穴环电流及其自旋轨道动力学的方法。
one_sentence_summary.en: A method is proposed to probe hole ring currents and their spin-orbit dynamics in atoms in real-time using attosecond transient-absorption circular dichroism.

problem.zh: 强场电离产生的空穴环电流具有超快动力学特性，但缺乏在亚周期时间尺度上对其进行状态分辨探测的有效手段。
problem.en: Hole ring currents generated by strong-field ionization exhibit ultrafast dynamics, but effective means for state-resolved detection on the subcycle timescale are lacking.

approach.zh: 结合理论推导与数值模拟，利用阿秒圆偏振XUV脉冲探测Kr离子的瞬态吸收，通过Wigner-Eckart定理将圆二色信号与空穴的角动量投影建立线性映射。
approach.en: Combining theoretical derivation and numerical simulation, the method uses attosecond circularly polarized XUV pulses to probe Kr ion transient absorption, establishing a linear mapping between the circular dichroism signal and hole angular momentum projections via the Wigner-Eckart theorem.

main_takeaway.zh: 阿秒圆二色谱能够作为X射线磁圆二色谱的超快时间域模拟，通过探测空穴相干性实现对环电流演化的全光学实时追踪。
main_takeaway.en: Attosecond circular dichroism spectroscopy serves as an ultrafast time-domain analog of X-ray magnetic circular dichroism, enabling all-optical real-time tracking of ring current evolution by probing hole coherence.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为理解强场电离中的离子-光电子纠缠及超快角动量交换提供了新的实验观测途径。
why_it_matters.en: This study provides a new experimental pathway for understanding ion-photoelectron entanglement and ultrafast angular momentum exchange in strong-field ionization.

reason.zh: 该工作成功将静态磁圆二色谱的求和规则推广至阿秒动力学，为超快磁性研究提供了关键的探测工具。
reason.en: The work successfully extends the sum rules of static magnetic circular dichroism to attosecond dynamics, providing a critical diagnostic tool for ultrafast magnetism research.

reason.zh: 该论文涉及阿秒物理与超快磁性的前沿交叉，符合该期刊对高影响力物理研究的偏好。
reason.en: The paper addresses the frontier intersection of attosecond physics and ultrafast magnetism, aligning with the journal's preference for high-impact physical research.
